records.title: How Much Progress Has There Been in NVIDIA Datacenter GPUs?
records.reason: This empirical survey quantifies datacenter-GPU performance, off-chip bandwidth, capacity, price and power trends, with explicit metric/data-selection methods. It documents compute growing faster than memory bandwidth and discusses data/method limitations, but does not propose an LLM optimization; relevance to quantization/inference is contextual only.

records.title: Passenger flow distribution forecasting at integrated transport hub via group evolution mechanism and multimodal data
records.reason: GEME-Net forecasts passenger flow at transport hubs; it is unrelated to LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: From Fuzzy to Exact: The Halo Architecture for Infinite-Depth Reasoning via Rational Arithmetic
records.reason: Halo proposes an exact-arithmetic reasoning architecture and specialized exact-integer hardware concept. The full text notes 1024-bit rational operations exceed ordinary per-thread GPU register budgets and cause severe spilling; it proposes lazy reduction and asynchronous reduction pipelines. This highly specialized design is not validated as a practical LLM inference optimization, so its architecture link is speculative.

records.title: Inference-Time Scaling for Visual AutoRegressive Modeling by Searching Representative Samples
records.reason: VAR-Scaling allocates inference-time compute by searching representative samples for vector-quantized visual autoregressive generation and evaluates quality versus additional sampling/search. This is a visual generation method rather than an LLM method; its connection to general inference-time scaling is adjacent, but transfer is unshown.

records.title: Artificial Entanglement in the Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
records.reason: The paper uses quantum-information concepts to analyze artificial entanglement during LLM parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Its contribution is interpretive analysis of training/adaptation, not inference cost or serving optimization.
